summary: WebSocket-controlled PTY shell and self-upgrade in @yeaft/webchat-agent
details: On startup the package connects to a configurable WebSocket server and routes inbound messages to handlers that grant the remote server full control of the installer's machine. `terminal_create` spawns a native PTY running the user's shell (bash/pwsh/cmd) and `terminal_input` writes server-supplied bytes directly into that PTY, providing interactive remote command execution. An `upgrade_agent` message causes the agent to run `npm view @yeaft/webchat-agent@latest version` and then `npm install @yeaft/webchat-agent@<latest>` via a detached shell/.bat script and restart itself, letting the server force arbitrary new code to be fetched and executed. `proxy_request` and `proxy_ws_open` messages let the server choose scheme, host, port, path, method, headers and body for outbound HTTP(S)/WS requests issued from the installer's host, with `rejectUnauthorized: false` disabling TLS verification, enabling SSRF and lateral movement into networks reachable from the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
